text_description: Cropped runway look focused from mid-torso to feet, built around a pale cream wrap-style upper layer tied at the front waist with a soft knot and long pointed sash ends falling over the hips; the visible fabric has a smooth scarf-like surface with burgundy and dark narrow border stripes, and a glimpse of pale blue/cream fabric above. Beneath the tied wrap is a deep black, floor-length lower garment that appears to be very wide-leg trousers or a divided skirt, cut with a fluid, loose silhouette and heavy drape, falling from the waist into broad vertical folds and nearly grazing the floor. The proportions contrast a compact, wrapped waist with voluminous black volume below. The model carries a small structured dark brown box handbag in one hand, suspended from a gold chain handle/strap with gold-toned hardware-like lines across the front. Footwear consists of red pointed-toe high-heeled pumps with a textured or patterned surface, visible under the long black hem as the model steps forward. Overall mood is polished resort/evening styling with scarf-wrap layering, graphic stripe accents, fluid black volume, metallic chain detail, and a red shoe accent.
